aviation_incidents.headline: 民航局舉辦2026飛航安全管理國際峯會 約200位專家與會
aviation_incidents.summary: 民航局舉辦2026年飛航安全管理國際峯會，約200位專家與高階主管與會。峯會首度連續舉辦兩日；民航局長何淑萍提出深化風險管理、深化安全文化及跨組織合作三面向，以提升飛航安全韌性。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Taiwan CAA opens 2026 aviation safety summit with about 200 attendees
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration opened the 2026 International Flight Safety Management Summit, attended by about 200 experts and senior executives. Held over two consecutive days for the first time, the summit highlighted deeper risk management, a stronger safety culture and cross-organisation cooperation to improve resilience.

sources.name: CAA Taiwan — 2026飛安峰會 串聯全球智慧展現臺灣民航韌性

aviation_incidents.headline: 汽車疑似衝撞萊比錫-哈雷機場圍籬並駛入數公尺 德國警方調查中
aviation_incidents.summary: 德國當局調查萊比錫-哈雷機場疑似闖入事件。汽車據報於2026年10月17日至18日夜間衝撞圍籬、向內行駛數公尺後逃離。截至10月19日，尚無官方歸責，也沒有嫌疑人遭逮捕。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Car reportedly breaches Leipzig-Halle airport fence and drives inside briefly; German authorities investigate
aviation_incidents.summary_en: German authorities are investigating an attempted breach at Leipzig-Halle airport. A car reportedly rammed a perimeter fence during the night of October 17–18, 2026, drove a few metres inside and fled. As of October 19, there was no official attribution and no suspects had been apprehended.

sources.name: AeroTime — German authorities investigate new security breach at Leipz…

aviation_incidents.headline: 美國航空A319乘客涉不當觸碰同座乘客 空服員將兩人分開且警方接機
aviation_incidents.summary: 一名美國航空A319乘客涉嫌在航班飛越威奇托時不當觸碰同座乘客。空服員接獲通報後將兩人分開，警方接應航機；相關行為仍屬指稱，並非已確認的犯罪結論。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Police meet American Airlines A319 after passenger allegedly gropes seatmate
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A passenger aboard an American Airlines A319 allegedly groped a seatmate while the flight was over Wichita. After receiving a report, flight attendants separated the pair, and police met the aircraft. The alleged conduct has not been established as a crime.

sources.name: Simple Flying — American Airlines A319 Met By Police After Passenger Allege…

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華信航空提出貨運價格脫鉤及敬老優惠票總量管制構想 貨運方案仍在檢討
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華信航空總經理莊明哲提出貨運價格脫鉤及敬老優惠票總量管制構想。公司今年第一季已向民航局提出貨運價格方案，目前仍在檢討；敬老優惠票總量管制仍在內部討論。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Mandarin Airlines proposes cargo-price changes and a cap on senior discount tickets; cargo plan remains under review
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Mandarin Airlines general manager Chuang Ming-che proposed decoupling cargo pricing and setting a total limit on discounted senior tickets. The airline submitted its cargo-pricing proposal to the Civil Aeronautics Administration in the first quarter, and it remains under review; the senior-ticket limit is still under internal discussion.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 國籍航空 — 國內線航空票價超過20年未漲 華信盼貨運價格脫鉤

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空增加布拉格、鳳凰城及安大略航班 評估達拉斯與芝加哥航點
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空將布拉格航線由每週3班增至4班，鳳凰城及安大略航線由每週4班增至5班。吉隆坡航線增為每日一班並改由A330執飛；公司也評估達拉斯與芝加哥作為新航點。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux increases Prague, Phoenix and Ontario flights and assesses Dallas and Chicago routes
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines increased Prague service from three to four flights weekly, and Phoenix and Ontario service from four to five weekly. Kuala Lumpur service rose to one daily flight and switched to the A330. The airline is also assessing Dallas and Chicago as potential new destinations.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 產經證券 — 航空業瞄準AI供應鏈拓點增班 角逐半導體商機

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空預計2027年底機隊達48架 明年營收估增至少四成
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空預計機隊由2026年底的42架增至2027年底的48架，並預估明年營收年增至少四成。公司表示，增長將受惠於交機加快、增班及拓展航點；油價是營運最大挑戰和變數。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux expects fleet to reach 48 aircraft by end-2027 and revenue to grow at least 40% next year
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines expects its fleet to grow from 42 aircraft at the end of 2026 to 48 by the end of 2027. It forecasts revenue growth of at least 40% next year, citing faster deliveries, more flights and route expansion; the airline identified oil prices as its biggest operational challenge and variable.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 國籍航空 — 星宇迎密集交機潮 明年營收拚增4成油價添變數

international_aviation.headline: Qantas Freight與Australia Post接收三架新增A321貨機首架 為年末旺季增運能
international_aviation.summary: Qantas Freight與Australia Post接收三架新增A321客改貨機中的首架，以增加年末購物旺季運能。其餘兩架預計於2027年3月前加入機隊；三架全數投入服務後，專用貨機網路運能最多可增20%。
international_aviation.headline_en: Qantas Freight and Australia Post receive first of three additional A321 freighters ahead of year-end peak
international_aviation.summary_en: Qantas Freight and Australia Post received the first of three additional A321 passenger-to-freighter aircraft to add capacity ahead of the year-end shopping peak. The other two are expected to join the fleet by March 2027. Once all three are in service, capacity on the dedicated freighter network is expected to increase by up to 20%.

sources.name: AeroTime — Qantas Freight and Australia Post welcome A321 freighter ah…

international_aviation.headline: 維珍大西洋航空開通希斯洛直飛普吉航班 成為兩地首條直飛服務
international_aviation.summary: 維珍大西洋航空於2026年10月18日開通倫敦希斯洛至泰國普吉的直飛航班，成為希斯洛與普吉之間首條直飛服務。航線以波音787-9執飛，規劃為冬季季節性航線，每週三班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Virgin Atlantic launches first nonstop Heathrow–Phuket service
international_aviation.summary_en: Virgin Atlantic began nonstop flights between London Heathrow and Phuket, Thailand, on October 18, 2026, establishing the first direct service between the two destinations. The seasonal winter route uses Boeing 787-9 aircraft and is planned to operate three times weekly.

sources.name: AeroTime — Virgin Atlantic launches first nonstop Heathrow-Phuket flig…

international_aviation.headline: ExecuJet Haite簽約在北京大興機場提供地面服務 將立即招募團隊
international_aviation.summary: ExecuJet Haite與Capital Airport Holding Business Aviation Management簽署具約束力協議，將在北京大興國際機場提供地面服務，並立即招募地面服務團隊。新協議擴大其在大興的業務角色。
international_aviation.headline_en: ExecuJet Haite signs binding ground-handling deal at Beijing Daxing and plans immediate hiring
international_aviation.summary_en: ExecuJet Haite signed a binding agreement with Capital Airport Holding Business Aviation Management to provide ground-handling services at Beijing Daxing International Airport. The company plans to begin hiring its ground-handling team immediately, expanding its role at the airport.
entities: Capital Airport Holding Business Aviation Management (CBM)

international_aviation.headline: Archer完成舊金山灣區載人示範飛行 Midnight原型機以奧克蘭機場為起訖點
international_aviation.summary: Archer表示，已於先前數週完成一系列舊金山灣區載人示範飛行，使用Midnight eVTOL原型機並以奧克蘭國際機場為起訖點。飛行途經灣區多個地點，並在涵蓋繁忙空中走廊的空域中操作。
international_aviation.headline_en: Archer completes piloted Bay Area demonstrations with Midnight prototype based at Oakland
international_aviation.summary_en: Archer said it completed a series of piloted demonstration flights over the San Francisco Bay Area in preceding weeks, using a Midnight eVTOL prototype and starting and ending at Oakland International Airport. The flights included stops around the region and operations in increasingly complex airspace, including busy air corridors.

international_aviation.headline: 聯合航空擴大短程航班餐點預訂 每日新增6.5萬名旅客可使用
international_aviation.summary: 聯合航空將餐點預訂服務擴大至較短程航班，每日新增6.5萬名旅客可使用。報導摘要另稱，每日新增提供這項服務的航班超過400班。
international_aviation.headline_en: United extends meal preordering to shorter flights, reaching 65,000 more flyers daily
international_aviation.summary_en: United Airlines has extended meal preordering to shorter flights, allowing 65,000 more flyers a day to use the service. The report separately says the change adds the service to more than 400 flights each day.

sources.name: Simple Flying — 65,000 More United Airlines Flyers A Day Can Now Preorder F…

international_aviation.headline: 澳洲航空與英國航空調整A380客艙配置 減少經濟艙座位
international_aviation.summary: 澳洲航空正在重新規劃一架總座位數為485席的A380客艙配置；英國航空則將從A380移除88個經濟艙座位。兩家航空公司均調整A380客艙，以減少經濟艙座位。
international_aviation.headline_en: Qantas and British Airways reconfigure A380 cabins to reduce economy seating
international_aviation.summary_en: Qantas is reworking the layout of a 485-seat Airbus A380, while British Airways is removing 88 economy seats from its A380s. Both airlines are adjusting their A380 cabin layouts to reduce economy seating.
